name: Captain Feed for YouTube
author: Dipak Dodiya

sections.description:
Captain Feed for YouTube allows you to easily display YouTube content on your WordPress website with full control over layout, styling, and behavior.

Whether you want to showcase your YouTube channel, playlist, or individual videos, this plugin makes it simple — no coding required.

Designed for performance and flexibility, it integrates smoothly with Elementor and works with any modern WordPress theme.

Perfect for creators, businesses, and marketers who want to grow their YouTube presence directly from their website.

Key Features

  • Display YouTube Channel Feeds
  • Show Playlist Videos
  • Embed Single or Multiple Videos
  • Fully customizable layout and design
  • Elementor-compatible controls
  • Responsive and mobile-friendly design
  • Lightweight and performance optimized
  • No coding required

Supported Feed Types

  • YouTube Channel Feed
  • YouTube Playlist Feed
  • Individual Video Feed
  • Mixed Video Showcase

Usage

After activation:

  • Add your YouTube Channel ID / Playlist ID / Video URL
  • Customize layout (grid, list, carousel, etc.)
  • Adjust styling (spacing, colors, thumbnails)
  • Publish and display your feed instantly

External Services

This plugin connects to the YouTube Data API v3 provided by Google to fetch YouTube channel information, playlists, and videos for display on your website.

What data is sent and when:

  • YouTube API Key
  • YouTube Channel ID
  • Playlist ID
  • Video ID
  • YouTube Username or Handle

This data is sent to Google’s servers only when:
– The feed is loaded
– Plugin settings are saved
– Cached feed data is refreshed

No visitor personal data is collected or transmitted by this plugin.

Service Provider: Google LLC
Terms of Service: https://developers.google.com/youtube/terms/api-services-terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/captain-feed-for-youtube directory, or install through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin from the ‘Plugins’ screen.
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and activated (optional but recommended).
  4. Open any page using Elementor or Gutenberg.
  5. Add and configure the YouTube Feed using available options.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

No, but Elementor support is included for better design control.

Can I show playlist videos?

Yes, you can display full YouTube playlists.

Can I display my entire channel feed?

Yes, simply enter your channel ID.

Is it beginner-friendly?

Absolutely! Everything is visual and easy to configure.
